pages.note: Published CLI under test is extension@4.1.3. Verified browser targets and comma-separated multi-target support (vendors() splits on ','), dist/<browser> output from a real build, Firefox service_worker->scripts translation (patch-gecko-background.ts), and all 8 cross-links resolve; only defect is a dangling empty section at the end.

Every flag, default and description in the table matches `extension inspect --help` verbatim; ran inspect with no session and got the documented E_SESSION_NOT_FOUND schema-1 envelope naming the exact dev command; tab shape {id,url,title,active,windowId}, logs.ndjson tail and `truncated` envelope field confirmed in source.

Glyphs, five channel colors, EXTENSION_DEBUG gate, Add-on/Extension noun rule and dist/extension-js/<browser>/{ready.json,events.ndjson} all confirmed by source and by a real build; the identity-card 'Binary row' claim is contradicted by the code and by dedicated specs.

open action/command payloads, the verbatim no-gesture warning string, `--name`, storage flags, the smoke:open-action script and the CI-templates anchor all check out; the GitHub Actions snippet is broken because `extension dev --wait` never boots a session.

Built a project containing pages/, scripts/, public/ and _locales/: pages/ and public/ behaved exactly as documented, the reserved-folder error text, Node indicators, public/manifest.json guard, watch add=warn/remove=error and store-URL companion support all confirmed; scripts/ silently drops unreferenced entries, contradicting the page.
`vue` is a real catalog template in `extension create --help` and the GitHub source link resolves, but the page describes and illustrates a different template than the one it tells you to scaffold.

Built a project with _locales/en + _locales/fr at the project root and a __MSG_ description: output landed at dist/<browser>/_locales/<locale>/messages.json as documented; LocalesLayoutWarning, the _locales-without-default_locale build failure, the @@ exemption and the @-in-key grammar all match feature-locales/validation.ts.

Mostly generic Babel setup prose; the one Extension.js-specific contract, the `config: (config) => Configuration` hook on FileConfig, exists at programs/develop/types.ts:640, and SWC is indeed the default pipeline.

No deno binary available so verified against source: write-deno-jsonc.ts confirms primary mode removes package.json, writes npm: imports incl. npm:extension@<version>, sets nodeModulesDir 'auto', and merges into a template-shipped deno.json; project-manifest.ts confirms package.json wins on conflict and package-manager.ts confirms the deno.lock / no-package.json / deno-on-PATH detection rule.

plugin-wasm/index.ts sets experiments.asyncWebAssembly = true, appends '.wasm' to resolve.extensions and aliases @ffmpeg/core, @imagemagick/magick-wasm and tesseract-wasm exactly as the page describes; transformers-js is a real template and its screenshot asset exists.

BUDGET_BYTES confirms 512 KiB content-script, 512 KiB service-worker and 1 MiB page, the plugin pushes compilation.warnings (never errors) and self-enables only when mode === 'production', and top-level `perfBudgets` is a real FileConfig key; the budget table omits one of the four real categories.
